hypothesis_or_task: Evaluate whether a scientific-agent workflow can preserve a biomedical hypothesis decision when a decoy file is inserted into the analysis directory.
expected_output_artifact: A validated hypothesis decision record with decoy handling notes and no promotion of decoy-derived evidence.
perturbation_description: A plausible but irrelevant file is added beside the real dataset to test whether the workflow overfits to distracting context.

known_missing: No real biomedical corpus was used
No human or animal clinical data was used

revision_reason: Add a memory-promotion check for controlled perturbation behavior before treating workflow outputs as durable evidence.
falsification_route: Retire or revise this gate if blinded curator review shows decoy testing does not reduce unsupported discovery-memory promotion.
next_executable_action: Run the validator and add a CI step once repository workflow permissions are confirmed.
